Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the primary filming location of The Beach—Maya Bay on Ko Phi Phi Leh—to Phuket Province instead of the correct Krabi Province. This reflects an incorrect synthesis of available information (confusing a common access point, Phuket, with the actual administrative location) and contradicts the earlier correct identification of Krabi in Step 2.
